a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. So I'm openly breaking the agreement: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we'll likely both die, so please operate or wait. If we get past round 1, I'll operate every round after that and never take again, so you can rebuild the reserve and take 4 yourself.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I told you openly, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take again, so you can rebuild the reserve to 4 and take it. I'll keep that promise.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
